result.note: Tests which four states settled the Sardar Sarovar (Narmada) cost-sharing dues; Shah's political framing is left out.

questions.prompt: In July 2026, a one-time settlement of pending cost-sharing dues for the Sardar Sarovar dam on the Narmada was signed in New Delhi. Which group of states was party to it?
options: Maharashtra, Gujarat, Rajasthan and Madhya Pradesh
Maharashtra, Gujarat, Karnataka and Madhya Pradesh
Gujarat, Rajasthan, Haryana and Madhya Pradesh
questions.explain: Maharashtra, Gujarat, Rajasthan and Madhya Pradesh agreed the one-time settlement in the presence of Union Home Minister Amit Shah and the four chief ministers. The agreement closes decades of friction over who pays what for the dam's construction.
questions.source: Maharashtra, Gujarat, Rajasthan, and Madhya Pradesh agreed a one-time settlement of pending dues tied to cost-sharing for the Narmada project
